policy: All automated gates must pass for an RC source/tarball build. Gates marked blocks1_0 must be completed with recorded evidence before Reeris 1.0. Gates marked blocksPublicPublication must be completed before publishing the corresponding public registry/repository artifacts.

gates.scope: Current stable Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari on supported desktop operating systems.
gates.evidence: Manual/browser-service run using the canonical fixtures and component acceptance matrix.
gates.automation: Playwright CI covers Chromium, Firefox and WebKit on Linux plus Microsoft Edge on Windows. Real Safari remains manual and Edge/Chrome branded-current validation remains an external release-lab check.

gates.scope: Safari on iOS/iPadOS and Chrome on Android, including touch, safe areas and native form controls.
gates.automation: Playwright emulates mobile Chromium and mobile WebKit for layout/touch prerequisites. Real iOS/iPadOS Safari and Android Chrome remain device/manual evidence.

gates.scope: Keyboard-only review plus representative screen-reader combinations such as NVDA/Firefox or Edge, VoiceOver/Safari and TalkBack/Chrome.
gates.evidence: Manual interaction notes for dialogs, popovers, forms, navigation, tables, disclosure and dynamic feedback.
gates.automation: Playwright keyboard flows verify focus order, native dialog/disclosure interaction and form controls; screen readers remain manual.

gates.scope: Real-browser 200% and 400% zoom/reflow, text expansion, coarse pointer and touch-target review.
gates.evidence: Completed browser/reflow fixture matrix with screenshots or test notes.
gates.automation: Playwright runs desktop/mobile viewport and touch-emulation smoke flows; real 200%/400% browser zoom remains manual.

gates.scope: Windows forced-colors/high-contrast review and prefers-contrast validation where available.
gates.evidence: Manual screenshots/notes demonstrating focus, selection, errors, boundaries and interactive controls.
gates.automation: Static forced-colors and contrast audits remain automated; Windows High Contrast visual confirmation remains manual.

gates.scope: Capture and approve the canonical visual matrix in a functioning browser/CI environment.
gates.evidence: Versioned PNG baselines plus a passing visual comparison run.
gates.automation: Playwright screenshot specs and snapshot update/compare commands are provided. Baselines require human approval before this gate can pass.

gates.scope: Confirm final project/package/repository/domain naming and perform appropriate trademark/conflict review before public launch.
gates.evidence: Recorded availability/clearance decision for Reeris UI and intended public package/repository names.
